<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="brandGlow" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#D52B1E"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#AB2D1F"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="yellowRed" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#D52B1E"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFEA28"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="blur35">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="35"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="shadow">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="125" rx="115" ry="92" fill="#D52B1E" opacity="0.7" filter="url(#blur35)"/>
  <ellipse cx="355" cy="245" rx="115" ry="125" fill="#F68E5A" opacity="0.6" filter="url(#blur35)"/>
  <ellipse cx="207" cy="718" rx="145" ry="100" fill="#FDC82F" opacity="0.28" filter="url(#blur35)"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="34" fill="#000000" opacity="0.92"/>
  <text x="20" y="22" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="321" y1="20" x2="321" y2="16" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="326" y1="20" x2="326" y2="13" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="20" x2="331" y2="10" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="344" cy="16" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="349" y1="12" x2="354" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="354" y1="17" x2="359" y2="12" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <rect x="367" y="10" width="19" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="369" y="12" width="14" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#FFEA28"/>
  <rect x="386" y="14" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="42" cy="75" r="22" fill="#D52B1E"/>
    <ellipse cx="36" cy="70" rx="4" ry="12" fill="#FFEA28" transform="rotate(-12 36 70)"/>
    <ellipse cx="48" cy="70" rx="4" ry="12" fill="#FFEA28" transform="rotate(12 48 70)"/>
    <text x="78" y="70" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="18px" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">McDonald's</text>
    <text x="78" y="89" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#AAAAAA">Join the community</text>
    <circle cx="354" cy="75" r="18" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.1" stroke="#FFFFFF4D"/>
    <line x1="348" y1="69" x2="360" y2="81" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="360" y1="69" x2="348" y2="81" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- glass form shadow and panel -->
  <rect x="20" y="111" width="350" height="596" rx="30" fill="#000000" opacity="0.65" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <rect x="20" y="106" width="350" height="596" rx="30" fill="#D52B1E" opacity="0.26" stroke="#FFFFFF4D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="27" y="113" width="336" height="582" rx="25" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.06"/>

  <text x="45" y="150" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="24px" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">Create account</text>
  <text x="45" y="174" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#EEEEEE">Save your favorites and get more from every order.</text>

  <!-- auth toggle -->
  <rect x="45" y="192" width="300" height="43" rx="22" fill="#000000" opacity="0.32" stroke="#FFFFFF4D"/>
  <rect x="47" y="194" width="146" height="39" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="120" y="219" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#D52B1E">Sign up</text>
  <text x="270" y="219" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" fill="#AAAAAA">Sign in</text>

  <!-- username field -->
  <text x="45" y="264" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Username or email</text>
  <rect x="45" y="273" width="300" height="48" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.1" stroke="#FFFFFF4D"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="297" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#EEEEEE" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="310" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#EEEEEE" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="88" y="302" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#AAAAAA">name@example.com</text>

  <!-- password -->
  <text x="45" y="350" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Password</text>
  <rect x="45" y="359" width="300" height="48" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.1" stroke="#FFFFFF4D"/>
  <rect x="64" y="378" width="14" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#EEEEEE" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="67,378 67,374 75,374 75,378" fill="none" stroke="#EEEEEE" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="319" cy="383" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#AAAAAA" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <line x1="313" y1="389" x2="325" y2="377" stroke="#AAAAAA" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <text x="91" y="388" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="16px" font-weight="600" fill="#EEEEEE">••••••••</text>
  <text x="45" y="426" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#AAAAAA">Use 8 or more characters with a number.</text>

  <!-- confirm password -->
  <text x="45" y="460" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Confirm password</text>
  <rect x="45" y="469" width="300" height="48" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.1" stroke="#FFFFFF4D"/>
  <rect x="64" y="488" width="14" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#EEEEEE" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="67,488 67,484 75,484 75,488" fill="none" stroke="#EEEEEE" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="319" cy="493" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#AAAAAA" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <line x1="313" y1="499" x2="325" y2="487" stroke="#AAAAAA" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <text x="91" y="498" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="16px" font-weight="600" fill="#EEEEEE">••••••••</text>

  <!-- preferences -->
  <rect x="45" y="545" width="17" height="17" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <polyline points="49,553 53,557 59,550" fill="none" stroke="#FFEA28" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="72" y="558" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#EEEEEE">I agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy</text>

  <!-- primary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="45" y="586" width="300" height="52" rx="26" fill="#AB2D1F" opacity="0.7"/>
    <rect x="45" y="583" width="300" height="52" rx="26" fill="#D52B1E"/>
    <text x="195" y="615" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Create my account</text>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="668" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#AAAAAA">Already have an account? <tspan fill="#FFEA28" font-weight="700">Sign in</tspan></text>

  <!-- bottom navigation shadow and surface -->
  <rect x="15" y="763" width="360" height="70" rx="30" fill="#000000" opacity="0.8" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <rect x="15" y="758" width="360" height="70" rx="30" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.1" stroke="#FFFFFF4D"/>
  
  <!-- home -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="51,786 61,778 71,786" fill="none" stroke="#8A8A8A" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="54" y="785" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#8A8A8A" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="61" y="817" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="500" fill="#8A8A8A">Home</text>
  </g>
  <!-- order -->
  <g>
    <rect x="133" y="779" width="18" height="18" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#8A8A8A" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="137" y1="785" x2="147" y2="785" stroke="#8A8A8A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="137" y1="790" x2="147" y2="790" stroke="#8A8A8A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="142" y="817" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="500" fill="#8A8A8A">Orders</text>
  </g>
  <!-- offers -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="218,779 236,779 240,788 236,797 218,797 214,788" fill="none" stroke="#8A8A8A" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="221" cy="788" r="2" fill="#8A8A8A"/>
    <text x="227" y="817" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="500" fill="#8A8A8A">Offers</text>
  </g>
  <!-- account selected -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="319" cy="783" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFEA28" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="319" cy="795" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#D52B1E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="319" cy="789" r="14" fill="none" stroke="#FFEA28" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <text x="319" y="817" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFEA28">Account</text>
  </g>
</svg>
